def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    total_billed_amount = 10000
    deductible = 1200
    coinsurance_rate = 0.20
    out_of_pocket_max = 3000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    remaining_cost = max(total_billed_amount - deductible, 0)
    coinsurance_cost = remaining_cost * coinsurance_rate
    total_out_of_pocket = min(
        deductible + coinsurance_cost,
        out_of_pocket_max
    )

    # return answer
    return round(total_out_of_pocket)
